answer:
I found 32 papers in the library that report AlpacaEval win rates for their own model or method. Three more are borderline and listed separately. I searched the text of all 2,275 PDFs: 76 mention AlpacaEval, and I sorted those by reading the passages around each mention. Page numbers are PDF page indices, which may differ from the numbers printed on the pages.

**Papers that report the win rates**

| Paper | Page(s) | What is reported |
|---|---|---|
| Mixture-of-Agents | p1, p5 (Table 2) | MoA scores 65.1% LC on AlpacaEval 2.0, and 65.7% with GPT-4o as the final aggregator |
| SimPO | p1, p2 (Table 1) | Gemma-2-9B-it-SimPO scores 72.4% LC, and SimPO beats DPO by up to 6.4 points |
| ORPO | p1, p2 | Mistral-ORPO-α/β score 11.33% / 12.20% on AlpacaEval 2.0 |
| KTO | p6, p18 | AlpacaEval (LC) for SFT+KTO and KTO models (p6); AlpacaEval 2 win rates for KTO variants (p18) |
| Self-Rewarding Language Models | p8 (Table 1) | AlpacaEval 2.0 win rate against GPT-4 Turbo for each self-rewarding iteration |
| Thinking LLMs (TPO) | p2, p5 (Table 1) | TPO scores 52.5% LC |
| RLHF Workflow | p12 | LC AlpacaEval-2 for their 8B model compared with other models |
| Unpacking DPO and PPO | p6 | AlpacaEval 2 win rates of 25.7–31.6 for PPO with different reward models |
| Checklists Are Better Than Reward Models (RLCF) | p7 (Table 4) | Vanilla and LC AlpacaEval for Qwen2.5-7B trained with RLCF and with baseline methods |
| Cheating Automatic LLM Benchmarks | p1, p6 (Table 2) | Their "null model" cheat gets 86.5% LC on AlpacaEval 2.0 |
| Safety Alignment Should Be More Than a Few Tokens Deep | p7 | Their augmented fine-tuned model has a 49.5% win rate against text-davinci-003 |
| Privacy-Preserving Instructions | p24 (Table 8) | AlpacaEval win rates for models trained on their differentially private synthetic instructions |
| Generalizing Verifiable Instruction Following | p20 (also p7) | Their model scores 31.6 on AlpacaEval 2 |
| Magpie | p8 (Table 1) | LC and raw win rates on AlpacaEval 2 for Llama-3-8B fine-tuned on Magpie data |
| UltraFeedback | p5 (Fig. 2), p6 (Table 3) | AlpacaEval win rate for UltraLM-13B-PPO and for best-of-n sampling with their reward model |
| WildFeedback | p8 | Phi-3's LC rises from 24.3% to 34.9% after training on WildFeedback |
| HelpSteer2 | p10 | AlpacaEval 2.0 LC for SFT, DPO, PPO and SteerLM models trained on HelpSteer2 |
| AgentInstruct (Orca-3) | p1, p16 | Orca-3 scores 24.80 on AlpacaEval, 45% above Mistral-Instruct |
| WizardLM | p7, p9 | AlpacaEval column for WizardLM-13b and its ablations |
| Self-Alignment with Instruction Backtranslation | p6 | AlpacaEval win rate against text-davinci-003 for their models |
| Generative Representational Instruction Tuning (GritLM) | p7, p9 | GritLM-8x7B-KTO scores 18.5 LC on AlpacaEval 2.0; AlpacaEval ablations on p9 |
| DataComp-LM | p10, p72 (Table 26) | DCLM-IT scores 16.6 LC on AlpacaEval 2.0 |
| OLMo | p8 (Table 4) | AlpacaEval %win of 57.0 for OLMo+SFT and 69.3 for OLMo+SFT+DPO |
| OLMo 2 | p11, p28 | AlpacaEval 2 results for OLMo 2 Instruct, and for each training stage on p28 |
| Olmo 3 | p7 (Table 1), p38 | AlpacaEval 2 LC for Olmo 3 / 3.1 Think and other variants |
| Tülu 3 | p6 (Table 2), p8 (Table 4) | AlpacaEval 2 LC win rate for the Tülu 3 models |
| Nemotron-4 340B | p14 | Nemotron-4-340B-Instruct scores 41.5 LC on AlpacaEval 2.0 |
| DeepSeek-V2 | p5, p18 | DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) scores 38.9 LC on AlpacaEval 2.0 |
| DeepSeek-V3 | p33 (Table 7) | DeepSeek-V3 scores 70.0 LC on AlpacaEval 2.0 |
| DeepSeek-R1 | p9 | AlpacaEval 2.0 LC across R1 stages; the final R1 improves it by 25% |
| Mixture/benchmark papers aside, two evaluation papers also count: | | |
| Preference Leakage | p20 (App. D.1) | Head-to-head AlpacaEval 2.0 win rates between their own student models. These are pairwise, not against the usual reference model. |

**Borderline, not counted above**
- **Length-Controlled AlpacaEval:** it introduces the LC metric and reports LC win rates throughout, but for existing leaderboard models rather than a model of its own (e.g. p1).
- **tinyBenchmarks:** its method estimates other models' AlpacaEval 2.0 scores from about 100 examples (p7).
- **Towards Spec Learning:** it reports length-controlled win rates "using the AlpacaEval-LC construction" (p17), but on its own judge data, not the AlpacaEval benchmark.

**Excluded:** the other papers only cite AlpacaEval, list it in surveys, or reuse its prompts or data. Examples are RewardBench (p3), Inverse Constitutional AI (p5), AxBench (p4) and URIAL (p7). Others report other models' scores, such as FollowBench (p8) and Arena-Hard (p7). Qwen2.5-Omni's "AlpacaEval" on p10 is a VoiceBench subtask score, not a win rate.
